name: fix-off-by-one
description: Fix an off-by-one error in pagination
prompt: In src/pager.js the function paginate(items, page, size) returns the wrong page: pages are numbered from 1, so page=1 must return the first `size` items, but it currently returns the second chunk. Fix the bug without changing the signature or the response shape { items, page, pages }. Add a test for the first and the last (partial) page in test/pager.test.js. Verify with: npm test.
